If you are looking for a destination that combines history, great food, and breathtaking views, Lisbon should be at the top of your list. I recently spent a weekend exploring this charming city, and it exceeded all of my expectations.

I started my first morning in the Alfama district, wandering through narrow cobblestone streets and soaking in the atmosphere. The climb up to the Sao Jorge Castle was well worth the effort, offering panoramic views of terracotta rooftops and the shimmering Tagus River. For lunch, I stopped at a tiny local restaurant and enjoyed grilled sardines with a glass of crisp vinho verde.

On day two, I took the famous Tram 28 to the Belem district, where I visited the stunning Jeronimos Monastery and, of course, tried the legendary pasteis de nata. In the evening, I listened to soulful fado music in a cozy tavern, which was an unforgettable experience.

Lisbon is a city that rewards curiosity. Whether you have two days or two weeks, you will find something to love. I cannot wait to go back!
